named_subject: a tornado funnel (an inverted cone with a spiral at the top)
action: The funnel stays in place near the centre of the frame and shifts a small distance left and right from frame to frame, while the grey cloud band behind it appears and disappears.
identity_gap: The funnel keeps the doodle's construction (open spiral top, tail stroke at the upper right, kinked left side, single bottom point) with only small changes in proportion.
notes: The film shows a nearly stationary tornado with slight camera shake, and the animation matches that stillness, but the funnel jumps sideways between frames and the grey cloud line switches on and off, so it reads as flicker rather than motion. The change that would help most is keeping the scenery lines present in every frame and easing the funnel's position between frames, ideally adding a slow rotation of the top spiral so the funnel visibly turns.
